units.source_text: 源氏想乘此机会把各位夫人所调制的香剂收集起来，

en.t: Genji wanted to take this opportunity to gather the incense blends prepared by the ladies,

units.source_text: 便派使者去对她们说：“今晚天雨，空气滋润，宜于试香。”

en.t: so he sent messengers to tell them, “It is raining tonight, and the damp air is perfect for testing incense.”

units.source_text: 于是各种精致的香剂都送来了。

en.t: Then all kinds of exquisitely made incense were sent in.

units.source_text: 源氏对萤兵部卿亲王说：“请你来评判优劣吧。

en.t: Genji said to Prince Hotaru, the Minister of War, “Please come and judge which are best and which are not.

units.source_text: 所谓‘除却使君外，何人能赏心？’也。”

en.t: As the saying goes, ‘Who but you could truly appreciate them?’”

units.source_text: 便命取香炉来试香。

en.t: He then ordered incense burners to be brought so they could test the scents.

units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王谦逊道：“我又不是‘知音’。

en.t: Prince Hotaru modestly said, “I am hardly such a connoisseur.

units.source_text: ”但并不推辞，

en.t: ” Yet he did not refuse,

units.source_text: 把各种美不可言的制品一一尝试，

en.t: and he tested each of the indescribably beautiful preparations one by one,

units.source_text: 指出所含香料过多或不足，

en.t: pointing out where an ingredient was too strong or too scant,

units.source_text: 些微缺点亦必挑剔，

en.t: and finding fault even with the smallest flaws,

units.source_text: 严格品定其优劣之差别。

en.t: as he strictly determined the differences in their quality.

units.source_text: 后来轮到源氏自己所制的两种香剂。

en.t: At last it was the turn of the two incense blends that Genji himself had made.

units.source_text: 在承和时代，香剂埋在宫中右近卫府旁御沟水边。

en.t: In the Jowa era, incense blends had been buried beside the imperial channel near the Right Division of the Inner Palace Guards.

units.source_text: 源氏仿此古法，

en.t: Following this old method,

units.source_text: 将自己所制两种香剂埋在西边走廊下流出的小溪附近。

en.t: Genji had buried the two blends he made near the little stream flowing out beneath the western corridor.

units.source_text: 此时便叫惟光的儿子兵卫尉掘出，

en.t: Now he had Koremitsu’s son, the Lieutenant of the Guards, dig them up,

units.source_text: 由夕雾中将接取，

en.t: and Lieutenant General Yugiri received them,

units.source_text: 送呈萤兵部卿亲王。

en.t: then presented them to Prince Hotaru, the Minister of War.

units.source_text: 亲王为难了，说道：“这个评判人真难当啊！

en.t: The prince was put in a difficult position and said, “This role of judge is truly hard to bear!

units.source_text: 被烟气熏坏了！”

en.t: I have been quite overwhelmed by all the smoke!”
